violation_type.title: Handwashing Sink Used Safely and Independently (26 TAC §747.4203(c))
violation_type.short_title: Handwashing Sink Used Safely and Independently
violation_type.typical_finding: Primary caregiver blocks children into one room and the space is blocked by a gate, children are not able to safely and independently walk to use hand washing sink.

finding_variants.text: Primary caregiver blocks children into one room and the space is blocked by a gate, children are not able to safely and independently walk to use hand washing sink.
There was no step stool for the smaller children to independently reach the handwashing sink.  This was corrected at the time of the inspection.
